1 Welcome Bonus: Effective as of April 30, 2025, Account must be approved, open and in Good Standing while this offer is in effect.

Welcome Bonus of 10% in Cash Back Dollars applies to new TD Cash Back Visa Infinite Accounts ("Account") in the first 3 months of Account opening ("First 3 Months") to a maximum total collective spend of $3,500 ("Welcome Bonus Cap") on any one or more of the following transactions charged to the Account at merchants classified by the Visa payment network's Merchant Category Code ("MCC") as Grocery Stores and Supermarkets (MCC 5411) ("Grocery Purchases"), or Gas Service Stations (MCC 5541), Automated Fuel Dispensers (MCC 5542), and Electric Vehicle Charging (MCC 5552) ("Gas & Electric Vehicle Charging Purchases"), or Local and Suburban Commuter Passenger Transportation, Including Ferries (MCC 4111) ("Public Transit Purchases"), or  Digital Goods Media – Books, Movies, Music (MCC 5815), Digital Goods – Games (MCC 5816), Digital Goods – Applications (MCC 5817), Digital Goods – Large Digital Goods Merchants (MCC 5818), Cable, Satellite and Other Pay Television/Radio/Streaming Services (MCC 4899) ("Streaming, Digital Gaming & Media Purchases"), or that are classified by the Visa payment network as recurring payments that are pre-authorized with a merchant to occur on a monthly or other regularly recurring basis ( "Recurring Bill Payments").
If you have any questions about the MCC that applies to a Purchase, contact TD at 1-800-983-8472.

In the first 3 months of Account opening, the Welcome Bonus of 10% in Cash Back Dollars listed above is in place of, and not in addition to, the earn rates listed within the TD Cash Back Program Terms and Conditions.

During the first year that the Account is open, the $15,000 Cap for each of (i) Grocery Purchases, (ii) Gas & Electric Vehicle Charging Purchases, (iii) Public Transit Purchases, and (iv) Recurring Bill Payments and Streaming, Digital Gaming & Media Purchases will be reduced by the actual corresponding amount of purchases in one of these categories (i) through (iv) made in the First 3 Months.

Other Conditions: Rebate of the Annual Fee is only for the first year for the Primary Cardholder and the first Additional Cardholder added to the Account. To receive the first-year annual fee rebate, you must activate your Card while this offer is in effect and make your first Purchase on the Account within the first 3 months after Account opening. To receive the first Additional Cardholder annual fee rebate you must add your first Additional Cardholder while this offer is in effect and the rebate will be applied within 2 monthly statements from the date of the statement with the first annual fee charge. The Primary Cardholder is responsible for all charges to the Account, including those made by any Additional Cardholder. The Special Offer Bonus and Welcome Bonus may be changed, withdrawn, or extended at any time and cannot be combined with any other offer unless otherwise indicated. This offer is not available customers who have activated and/or closed a TD Cash Back Visa Infinite Account in the last 12 months. We reserve the right to amend the offer on your Account to reflect the current offer available at the time of your TD Credit Card activation if your Card has not been activated while this offer is in effect. Your Account must be in Good Standing at the time the Cash Back Dollars are awarded.
† Offer Effective as of April 30, 2025. The value of up to $600 could be earned in the first year of Account opening and is based on the combined value of:
  • $189: Annual fee rebate for the Primary Cardholder ($139) and first Additional Cardholder ($50) for the first year;
  • $350: Earn a cumulative 10% in Cash Back Dollars on eligible Grocery, Gas & Electric Vehicle Charging, Public Transit, Recurring Bill Payments, and Streaming, Digital Gaming & Media Purchases in the first three months of account opening until $3,500 in such Purchases have been made.
  • $89: Receive 24/7 Roadside Assistance with Free Deluxe TD Auto Club membership.
5 Any returned items, refunds, rebates, or other similar credits will reduce or cancel Cash Back Dollars earned on the original Purchase. Fees, Cash Advances (including Balance Transfers, and Cash-Like Transactions), interest charges, optional service, refunds, rebates or other similar credits do not earn Cash Back Dollars. For more details, please review the TD Cash Back Program Terms and Conditions at td.com/agreements. Other Conditions: Offer may be changed, withdrawn or extended at any time and cannot be combined with any other offer. The Account must be open & in Good Standing on the date Cash Back Dollars are awarded to qualify.

Annual interest rates, fees and features are current as of June 1, 2026, unless otherwise indicated and subject to change.

All trade-marks are the property of their respective owners. For trade-mark ownership details, see www.tdcanadatrust.com/aeroplancards

1 Welcome Bonus: Effective as of April 30, 2025, Account must be approved, open and in Good Standing while this offer is in effect.

Welcome Bonus of 10% in Cash Back Dollars applies to new TD Cash Back Visa Infinite Accounts ("Account") in the first 3 months of Account opening ("First 3 Months") to a maximum total collective spend of $3,500 ("Welcome Bonus Cap") on any one or more of the following transactions charged to the Account at merchants classified by the Visa payment network's Merchant Category Code ("MCC") as Grocery Stores and Supermarkets (MCC 5411) ("Grocery Purchases"), or Gas Service Stations (MCC 5541), Automated Fuel Dispensers (MCC 5542), and Electric Vehicle Charging (MCC 5552) ("Gas & Electric Vehicle Charging Purchases"), or Local and Suburban Commuter Passenger Transportation, Including Ferries (MCC 4111) ("Public Transit Purchases"), or  Digital Goods Media – Books, Movies, Music (MCC 5815), Digital Goods – Games (MCC 5816), Digital Goods – Applications (MCC 5817), Digital Goods – Large Digital Goods Merchants (MCC 5818), Cable, Satellite and Other Pay Television/Radio/Streaming Services (MCC 4899) ("Streaming, Digital Gaming & Media Purchases"), or that are classified by the Visa payment network as recurring payments that are pre-authorized with a merchant to occur on a monthly or other regularly recurring basis ( "Recurring Bill Payments").

If you have any questions about the MCC that applies to a Purchase, contact TD at 1-800-983-8472.

In the first 3 months of Account opening, the Welcome Bonus of 10% in Cash Back Dollars listed above is in place of, and not in addition to, the earn rates listed within the TD Cash Back Program Terms and Conditions. 

During the first year that the Account is open, the $15,000 Cap for each of (i) Grocery Purchases, (ii) Gas & Electric Vehicle Charging Purchases, (iii) Public Transit Purchases, and (iv) Recurring Bill Payments and Streaming, Digital Gaming & Media Purchases will be reduced by the actual corresponding amount of purchases in one of these categories (i) through (iv) made in the First 3 Months.

Other Conditions: Rebate of the Annual Fee is only for the first year for the Primary Cardholder and the first Additional Cardholder added to the Account. To receive the first-year annual fee rebate, you must activate your Card while this offer is in effect and make your first Purchase on the Account within the first 3 months after Account opening. To receive the first Additional Cardholder annual fee rebate you must add your first Additional Cardholder while this offer is in effect and the rebate will be applied within 2 monthly statements from the date of the statement with the first annual fee charge. The Primary Cardholder is responsible for all charges to the Account, including those made by any Additional Cardholder. The Special Offer Bonus may be changed, withdrawn, or extended at any time and cannot be combined with any other offer unless otherwise indicated. This offer is not available customers who have activated and/or closed a TD Cash Back Visa Infinite Account in the last 12 months. We reserve the right to amend the offer on your Account to reflect the current offer available at the time of your TD Credit Card activation if your Card has not been activated while this offer is in effect. Your Account must be in Good Standing at the time the Cash Back Dollars are awarded.

Subject to the above conditions, under this offer you are eligible to receive: (a)(I) 10,000 bonus Aeroplan points ("Welcome Bonus") after the first eligible purchase is made on the Account; (II) an additional 15,000 bonus Aeroplan points ("Additional Bonus"), if $3,000 in net purchases (including the first purchase, less any returns and credits) is made on the Account within [90 days] of Account opening; and (III) a one-time anniversary bonus of 15,000 Aeroplan points ("Anniversary Bonus"), if the Account remains open and active for 12 months and $12,000 in net purchases (including the first purchase, less any returns and credits) is made on the Account within 365 days of Account opening; and (b) an annual fee rebate only for the first year of the Account for the primary cardholder and up to 3 additional cardholders (each, a "First Year Rebate") that will only be received if the Account is in good standing at the time the rebate is to be applied and: (I) the primary cardholder of the Account activates their credit card and the first eligible purchase is made on the Account within the first 3 months after Account opening; and (II) provided the primary cardholder conditions in (b)(I) are met, the additional cardholder(s) is/are added to the Account within [3 months] of Account opening.  The applicable First Year Rebate will be applied by TD to the Account within 2 monthly statements from the date of the first statement on which an applicable annual fee charge appears.

TD reserves the right to: (i) limit the number of credit card accounts opened by one person, (ii) limit the number of points available under this offer for the Welcome Bonus, Additional Bonus and Anniversary Bonus, and (iii) terminate or suspend, in whole or part, or modify this offer in any way at any time.  This offer cannot be combined with any other offer unless otherwise indicated. The Account must be in good standing at the time the Welcome Bonus, Additional Bonus and Anniversary Bonus are issued by Aeroplan. Please allow up to 8 weeks after the conditions for each element of this offer are fulfilled for the Welcome Bonus, Additional Bonus and Anniversary Bonus to be issued by Aeroplan and credited to the Aeroplan member account linked to the Account, which must belong to the primary cardholder. Closing the Account or transferring to another TD credit card account may result in forfeiture of any bonus points not yet awarded under this offer.

4 You are responsible for ensuring the mobile phone number we have on file is accurate and for notifying us of any changes. We will send the TD Fraud Alerts text message instantly upon detection of suspicious activity; however, receipt of the text message may be delayed or prevented due to a variety of factors such as technology failures, service outages, or multiple third-party involvement. TD Fraud Alerts text messages will only be sent to customers who have a Canadian mobile phone number and a Canadian mailing address in their TD Customer Profile.

6 A Primary Cardholder or Additional Cardholder, and up to eight (8) other passengers travelling on the same reservation (up to a maximum of nine (9) travellers), are each entitled to a free first checked bag up to 23kg/50lbs. Benefit only applies when checking in with Air Canada, for a flight operated by Air Canada, Air Canada Rouge or under the Air Canada Express brand. Benefit is not available if check-in is with another airline. If the first checked bag is already complimentary (for example, as a result of Aeroplan Elite Status or fare purchased), there is no additional checked bag benefit that will be provided. Free first checked bag benefit may not be applied retroactively, and no refunds will be issued. Service charges for additional/oversized/overweight baggage may apply. More information on baggage restrictions.

7 You will receive one $100.00 TD Travel Credit on your first Eligible Travel Credit Purchase posted to the Account in a calendar year. In order to receive the TD Travel Credit, the Account must be open, Active and in Good Standing. An Eligible Travel Credit Purchase means:

  • A Hotel, Motel, Lodging, or Vacation Rental Purchase of $500.00 CAD or more made with Expedia For TD; or
  • A Vacation Package Purchase of $500.00 CAD or more made with Expedia For TD, that includes a Hotel, Motel, Lodging or Vacation Rental booking packaged with a transportation booking.

See your TD Rewards Program Terms and Conditions for more details.
